newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal gets $51 mln IMF loan for economic reform.
newsitem.headline: Senegal gets $51 mln IMF loan for economic reform.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund has granted Senegal a $51 million loan to help with economic reform, finance ministry officials said on Monday.
The loan is an Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility. The ministry said Senegal had met its 1995-96 economic targets.
Gross Domestic Product growth in 1996 was an estimated 5.2 percent against 4.8 percent in 1995. Inflation was held to around 2.7 percent in 1996.
The 1997 growth target is at least 4.5 percent, the inflation target is 2.5 percent.The government aims to cut the budget deficit to one percent of GDP in 1997 from around two percent in 1996.
Its target is to balance the budget and record a surplus in 1999 by increasing government revenue and cutting back on non-urgent spending.
